restrictions: Use only 64-byte messages, fixed-IV SHA-256 indices 0 through 30 on both padded blocks, full feed-forward, and the full 256-bit digest.
Draw two fresh independent uniform 256-bit RAM words for each of exactly 2^129 messages; deterministic seed expansion is not a substitute.

Collision detection sorts the charged three-word records by the 256-bit digest with a two-pass least-significant-digit radix (counting) sort, 2^128 buckets per pass, fully charged in both the time and memory ledgers.

Require distinct messages and verify a returned pair by complete re-hashing. Memory is a reported metric only and contributes nothing to the scalar; the 2^128-word count arrays are therefore permitted.
preprocessing is inside total time; nonuniform_advice_log2_bytes=0 is a one-byte upper bound with zero actual advice.
This is an unconditional analytic construction with no experiments, computed witness, hidden precomputed search, or claimed improvement over the nominal reference.
